infrastructure.zh: 企业 AI 基础设施

desc.zh: 模型部署与推理在企业环境里，怎样才算可靠。
desc.en: What makes model deployment and inference dependable inside a business.

desc.zh: 算力的成本从哪里来，中小企业怎样才用得起。
desc.en: Where the cost of computing comes from, and how smaller businesses can afford it.

desc.zh: 怎样用 AI 更快、更诚实地检验需求与商业模式。
desc.en: How AI can test demand and business models faster and more honestly.

desc.zh: 早期团队与独立创业者在融资和成长中遇到的真实障碍。
desc.en: The real obstacles early teams and independent founders meet in fundraising and growth.

desc.zh: 把 AI 系统交付到生产环境的方法与教训。
desc.en: Methods and lessons from shipping AI systems into production.

name.zh: 企业级 AI 基础设施

desc.zh: 为模型部署、推理和业务应用提供可靠、可扩展的 AI 基础设施。
desc.en: Reliable, scalable AI infrastructure for model deployment, inference, and business applications.

desc.zh: 灵活、划算的算力方案，让中小企业也能用上 AI、放手创新。
desc.en: Flexible, cost-effective computing solutions that make AI adoption and innovation accessible to small and medium-sized businesses.

desc.zh: 用 AI 做需求验证、商业模式测试和流程自动化，缩短从想法到市场的路。
desc.en: AI-powered demand validation, business model testing, and workflow automation to accelerate the journey from idea to market.

name.en: Venture Capital Access for Early-Stage Startups

desc.zh: 为 A 轮前的创业团队对接投资人与创投资源，帮助做好融资准备、支持早期成长。
desc.en: Investor connections and venture resources for pre-Series A startups, supporting fundraising readiness and early-stage growth.

desc.zh: 把 AI、算力与资本对接放在一起，帮助创业者和独立专业人士把专长与想法变成可持续的事业。
desc.en: Bringing together AI, computing, and capital access to help founders and independent professionals turn expertise and ideas into sustainable businesses.
